title: Shedding policy emulator and chaos harness for regional failovers
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Build a reproducible emulator and chaos-testing harness to validate load-shedding policies (priority queues, admission control, graceful degradation) across multi-region failover scenarios. The tool will let us model tenant mixes, request size distributions, regional capacity shifts, and circuit-breaker tripping, and will produce deterministic scenario replays plus metrics/plots for SLO regressions. Goal is to catch unexpected behavioral regressions before rollout and to provide a library of canonical failure scenarios for CI and runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Emulator can run 10 canonical scenarios (see task list) with deterministic replay from recorded traces
Policy instrumentation emits the same metric set as production (latency p50/p95/p99, accept_rate, preempt_count, fallback_count)
Integration test that runs in CI and fails on >5% SLO regression compared to baseline
Dashboard in Grafana showing side-by-side baseline vs scenario results and differential alerts
Runbook snippets generated for the top 3 failure modes with recommended operator actions
tasks: Design data model for scenario definitions (tenant weight, request size distro, regional capacity timeline)
Add lightweight emulator hooks into admission controller and priority queue code paths
Capture and sanitize production traces for seed traffic patterns
Implement scenario runner with region failover and circuit-breaker injectors
Wire metrics export compatible with prod observability stack
Create CI workflow that runs smoke + 3 full scenarios nightly
Author Grafana dashboard and runbook generation templates
Document usage and onboarding for SRE and PMs
comments: 2025-09-03 - Ava Martinez: Created ticket after postmortem for REGION-2 failover showed unexpected tenant starvation under legacy policies. Proposal: emulator to validate policy changes before rollout.
2025-09-04 - Leo Chen: Initial design sketch uploaded to Confluence; leaning towards a scenario DSL (yaml) so SREs can author cases without code changes. Need to agree schema for 'capacity timeline'.
2025-09-05 - Priya Kapoor (PM): +1 on DSL. Please ensure scenarios include mixed short/long tail requests and embedding-only workloads. We'll provide 2 customer templates for validation.
2025-09-06 - Design review with SRE & Runtime: feedback to keep emulator outside hot path; should be able to run against a 'shadow' admission controller using real kernels but synthetic inputs.

2025-09-08 - Leo Chen: Hook added to admission controller to accept a replay stream; pushed draft PR (see links). Early runs show a case where low-priority tenants are preempted more aggressively than intended when circuit breaker trips—investigating alignment with token-bucket logic.

2025-09-10 - Ava Martinez: Ran first full scenario (regional failover + surge). Results attached to dashboard proto; p95 increased by 18% for mid-priority group due to backpressure routing. Next: tune fallback threshold and add canary job in dedicated staging to iterate.
